scope: First local Java migration HTTP smoke, not a performance result
observed: HTTP assertions reached restart/readback, but disposable cleanup failed with Windows file-in-use error. No complete success report was emitted.
diagnosis: The java executable on PATH was an Oracle javapath launcher. After the subprocess handle exited, two actual JDK JVM child processes were still running and retaining the log file.
repair: Resolve java.home from runtime properties and invoke that JDK executable directly so shutdown waits for the actual JVM. The two verified task-owned JVM processes were stopped and the checked disposable directory was cleaned.
